2026-10-07: addressed the three status-assessment gaps in the shared worktree. Public GLS exposes checked ArBiasCorrection.OlsDesign / Ols policy through typed/legacy recipes and portable JSON. Dense, voxelwise, runwise and bounded pooled preparation use the matching OLS design; bounded summaries validate every residual block, accumulate the full correction lag budget, merge with Gale ExactSum and correct once after reduction. Diagnostics and schema-v2 prepared artifacts preserve actual per-run/per-voxel outcomes; legacy raw identities/artifacts remain compatible. Corrected fixed-coefficient, iterative-GLS and robust requests are refused because the current correction is specifically for OLS residuals. Fixed/filter ARMA remains supported; ARMA estimation, parcel pooling and mean-series estimands are explicitly dispositioned in the audit table.

Added public end-to-end R parity: six shared/global/run/voxelwise AR(1)/AR(2) cases and two runwise cases, through final coefficients, covariance, standard errors, residual variance and rdf. Fixed the full-rank voxelwise QR pivot-order merge restriction while retaining deficient alias checks. Added exact corrected-summary pooling, fallback, recipe, artifact and lock-routing coverage.

Bias and consumer fixtures are now hash-checked auxiliary receipts using a separate exact R 4.5.1 / fmriAR ca27f277 / fmrireg 5bd3ad14 lock. Scheduled regeneration runs the old and corrected reference groups in order. Final regeneration of both corrected generators repeated byte-identically for all four JSON/Scala artifacts.

Fresh gates: arJVM 158, arJS 156, modelJVM/modelJS 56 each, fitJVM 699, fitJS 642; all passed, zero compiler warnings. scalafimCompileAll passed warning-clean. Python receipt/freshness tests 6 passed, 13 external receipts checked, 38 scenario entries validated. No new PHRF heavy-bias, hosted-CI or performance qualification.

Audit: docs/audits/ar-fmriar-fmrireg.md. Source-bound logs and hashes: docs/verification/ar-consumer-closure-20261007/summary.json. Code is uncommitted in the shared worktree; no publication. Ready for review of this bounded consumer/audit closure.
